About us

GoCardless, a Mollie company, is a global leader in bank payments. Over 100,000 businesses, from start-ups to household names, use GoCardless to collect, manage and send bank payments through Direct Debit, real-time payments and open banking. With US$130bn+ processed annually across 30+ countries, we handle recurring and one-off payments without the chasing, stress, or expensive fees. Our end-to-end payment platform also features AI-powered solutions to improve payment success and reduce fraud, alongside connections to over 350 platforms businesses use everyday.

We are headquartered in the UK, with teams and operations spanning North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific. For more information, please visit www.gocardless.com and follow us on LinkedIn @GoCardless.

Mollie is the leading payments and financial services partner for business, rooted in Europe, with global reach.

The role

The Fraud Risk Management team ensures that GoCardless adopts, implements and maintains innovative and appropriate controls as we have a duty to banking partners, regulators, schemes, merchants and their customers to review and monitor accounts and transactions with the utmost care.

As a Fraud Investigation Specialist you’ll be working as part of a small, close-knit team, conducting fraud investigations, with the aim of protecting GoCardless from fraud, financial and reputational risk.

The reason why we have this role open in an additional headcount - we are looking for an extra set of hands!

On a daily basis you will:

- Monitor the risk alert queue and identify high risk behaviour within the business portfolio

- Conduct fraud investigations within service level agreements to reduce potential revenue losses

- Attain a thorough understanding of GoCardless’ product, policies and processes

- Lead on customer-facing correspondence and work with various teams across the business to ensure we provide a seamless merchant experience

What excites you

- The opportunity to work in a high performing team and make important daily decisions that can make an impact on GoCardless’s future success

- Having the opportunity to learn more about data and how to use it to make informative decisions across the business

- Working in a global fraud team where you can share experiences and learn from other team members who come from a variety of industries

What excites us

- You have hands-on experience in a fraud investigations role or similar and are looking for your next challenge

- You use logic and reasoning to separate legitimate behaviour from suspected illicit activity

- You are comfortable with making accurate, fast decisions depending on the evidence at hand

- You understand the implications of new information for both current and future problem-solving and decision-making

- You use your written English skills to strike the right tone with internal and external stakeholders.

- You’re driven by initiative, and understand the impact of every decision you make on our merchants

- Results-focused: You can prioritise, organise, and show initiative and willing to get the job done

Ro is a direct-to-patient healthcare company with a mission of helping patients achieve their health goals by delivering the easiest, most effective care possible. Ro is the only company to offer nationwide telehealth, labs, and pharmacy services. This is enabled by Ro's vertically integrated platform that helps patients achieve their goals through a convenient, end-to-end healthcare experience spanning from diagnosis, to delivery of medication, to ongoing care. Since 2017, Ro has helped millions of patients in nearly every single county in the United States, including 99% of primary care deserts.
 
Ro is consistently recognized as a top workplace in Health Care, in New York, and for Women and Parents—earning more than 20 honors from Fortune, Great Place to Work, and PEOPLE since 2021. In 2025 alone, we ranked top 5 among medium workplaces in Health Care and New York, and top 50 nationwide.

Patient Advocates are part of the Care Delivery team, supporting our patients and network of providers as the non-clinically licensed members of a patient’s healthcare team. Working alongside Registered Nurses and Practitioners, Patient Advocates provide non-clinical administrative support to providers and empathetic, high-touch service to patients. Patient Advocates serve as a connection point between patients, providers, pharmacies, and insurance partners, helping patients navigate their care experience and resolve non-clinical needs. They answer patient questions, investigate more complex issues, communicate clear next steps, and provide additional support when patients need help moving through the treatment journey. Through proactive problem-solving, clear communication, and patient advocacy, Patient Advocates help create a seamless, supportive healthcare experience at Ro.

- Provide empathetic, high-touch support to patients anticipating needs, answering non-clinical questions, and proactively helping patients navigate their care experience

- Support providers with non-clinical administrative tasks in the Care Center (our Electronic Medical Record), including triaging, reassigning, and resolving patient messages accurately and efficiently

- Investigate and navigate complex patient situations, working with clinical, pharmacy, insurance, and operational teams to resolve issues and translate complex information into clear, actionable next steps for patients

- Contact pharmacies and insurance providers to assist patients with non-clinical prescription needs or issues, including benefits verification and prior authorizations

- Partner with cross-functional team mates within the organization and medical practice to balance patient needs, share knowledge, and contribute to team service, quality, and operational goals

- Surface recurring patient, provider, or workflow issues and provide feedback to help improve the patient experience and team operations

- Participate in pilots and new initiatives that improve patient support, expand retention opportunities, or optimize operations

- 1–2 years of experience in a patient-facing administrative, healthcare, customer service, or operations role

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate complex information clearly and empathetically

- Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail, with the ability to investigate issues, identify next steps, and follow through to resolution

- Excellent time management and organizational skills, with the ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, asynchronous environment

- Demonstrated proficiency and comfort utilizing diverse technological tools and platforms to research and resolve patient inquiries; prior experience with EHR systems is strongly preferred

- Comfort working with internally-approved LLM-based message systems, ability to critically review LLM-generated content for accuracy

- Comfort utilizing internally-approved AI-based tooling for day-to-day workflows, comfort prompting AI tooling

- Comfort working toward defined service, productivity, and quality expectations and metrics

- Experience with health insurance plans, benefits verification, and/or prior authorizations preferred

The Role We Need:

As a member of the escalations team, you are considered a senior member of the Customer Experience organization. This role involves handling more complex or escalated inquiries that require a higher level of expertise and customer service finesse. Advocates in this position need to be proactive problem-solvers equipped with a strong understanding of our policies, procedures, and the unique needs of our members. By collaborating closely with other departments and utilizing feedback, they contribute to refining our support processes and enhancing the overall member experience.

The ideal person should have a knack for problem-solving, especially in situations that require thoughtful analysis and a careful approach. Exceptional communication skills are essential, as the role involves conveying information clearly and confidently to our members while resolving their issues. We're looking for someone who thrives in a collaborative environment, works well across teams, and can actively contribute to improving our support processes. Above all, the ideal candidate is committed to creating a positive experience that builds trust and satisfaction among our members.

- Act as the main escalation point for complex Member support issues that need effective critical thinking, research, and problem-solving abilities.

- Manage a range of complex cases, such as policy-related inquiries, financial disputes, platform issues, and membership matters.

- Assume responsibility for cases from beginning to end, ensuring a prompt and satisfactory resolution.

- Serve as the representative of PadSplit, ensuring that all interactions are conducted with empathy, professionalism, and efficiency.

- Develop innovative solutions for the unique challenges that arise, balancing both member needs and company policies.

- Assist and educate members about our platform, policies, and product offerings, ensuring they fully understand their options.

- Maintain an in-depth understanding of our ever-evolving web and mobile products, processes, and policies.

- Identify recurring issues and trends, offering insights and suggestions for process and policy improvements to enhance the Member experience.

- Serve as the voice of the customer, advocating for members’ needs and supporting ongoing improvements in our Customer Experience (CX) operations.

- Collaborate closely with other teams, such as Product, Operations, and Host Support, to guarantee a seamless experience for our Members.

- Assume responsibility for special projects within the Customer Experience team, contributing to process enhancements and operational efficiency.

Here’s What You’ll Need To Be Successful:

- Comfortable working in a fast-paced, ever-evolving environment where priorities can shift quickly.

- Able to stay composed under pressure while handling complex Member interactions.

- Strong verbal and written communication skills, ensuring clarity and professionalism in every interaction.

- Ability to break down complex topics and explain them in a clear, concise, and empathetic manner.

- A natural problem-solver who can analyze information, investigate issues, and think critically to resolve complex Member concerns.

- Ability to develop creative solutions while balancing Member needs and company policies.

- Energized by customer interactions, with a genuine passion for helping others and enhancing the Member experience.

- Skilled at balancing empathy with firmness, ensuring fair and effective resolutions.

- Ability to prioritize multiple tasks, manage workloads efficiently, and meet response time expectations.

- Highly detail-oriented and capable of tracking cases through resolution.

- Comfortable navigating multiple systems, online platforms, and support tools.

- Able to quickly adapt to new technologies, processes, and policy changes.

- Possesses a strong sense of intellectual curiosity, eager to learn, adapt, and improve.

- A collaborative team player with a positive, "can-do" attitude, always ready to support colleagues and contribute to team success.

The Interview Process:

- Your application will be reviewed for possible next steps by the Hiring Manager.

- If you meet eligibility requirements, the next step would be a video interview with a member of the PeopleOps team for about thirty (30) minutes.

- If warranted, the next step would be a video interview with our Manager of T2 Member Support for forty (40) minutes. For this interview, we will assess your overall fit with a set of role-related questions.

- If warranted, we move to offer!

Compensation is based on the role's scope, national market benchmarks, the person's expertise and experience, and the impact of their contributions to our business goals.

About Dutchie

Founded in 2017, Dutchie is a comprehensive technology platform powering dispensary operations, while providing consumers with safe and easy access to cannabis. Dutchie aims to further support the positive societal change the cannabis industry brings to the world through wellness benefits, social justice, and empowering local communities through tax revenue. Powering thousands of dispensaries across 40+ markets throughout the United States and Canada, Dutchie is the leading technology company in the cannabis space and was named in Fast Company’s 10 Most Innovative Companies in North America and listed two years in a row on LinkedIn’s Top 50 Startups.

Dutchie has raised over $600M in funding to date, backed by D1 Capital Partners, Tiger Global, Dragoneer, DFJ Growth, Thrive Capital, Howard Schultz, Snoop Dogg’s Casa Verde Capital, Gron Ventures, members of the founding team at DoorDash, Kevin Durant’s Thirty Five Ventures, and other notable angel investors.

About This Job

Dutchie is on a mission to make cannabis accessible — and we do that by building the technology that powers dispensaries end-to-end: point of sale, ecommerce, payments, loyalty, and marketing. Our Support team sits at the center of that mission. When something isn't working for a dispensary, we're the ones who make it right; fast, sharp, and calm.

The Product Support Specialist is our frontline expert across the full Dutchie platform. You'll own inbound contacts for our full stack of products, troubleshoot technically complex issues, navigate multiple systems, and be the person dispensary staff rely on when things get hard in the middle of a busy shift. Many of the analysts, engineers, implementation strategists, operations specialists, and more started in this exact position or very similar, meaning this can be a launchpad for future career growth.

One more thing worth being direct about: Dutchie is actively building AI into how cannabis retail operates. We utilize AI-powered support products, and we're rolling out agentic modules across the platform that change how dispensaries interact with their technology. AI isn't a tool we use on the side, it's woven into the product you'll be supporting and the workflow you'll operate in every day. We're looking for someone genuinely curious about these tools, invested in learning them, and willing to push on them when they fall short. If you've been waiting for a support role where the technology is actually interesting, this is it.

What You’ll Do

Customer interaction and resolution

- Handle inbound contacts via email, phone, and live chat across POS, ecommerce, payments, loyalty, hardware, and integrations

- Troubleshoot complex platform issues: back office configuration, register transactions, receipt reconciliation, menu sync failures, discount and pricing issues

- Support hardware setup and troubleshooting across registers, printers, barcode scanners, cash drawers, scales, and computers

- De-escalate high-urgency situations, dispensary customers are often mid-shift, and the stakes are real

- Know when to escalate to a higher level or move to a call or Zoom rather than continuing to trade messages

Payments and compliance

- Triage Pay by Bank issues: bank linking, funding delays, authorization errors, returns, and suspected fraud

- Support basic METRC and compliance workflows: package tags, manifest generation, transfer workflows

- Escalate compliance-adjacent issues to Tier 2 with complete documentation

Inventory, products, and integrations

- Assist with inventory receiving, package creation, inventory room management, and audit workflows

- Support catalog management, label configuration, and pricing updates

- Validate integration setup, triage syncing issues, and process API key requests

AI tool usage and platform evolution

- Work alongside AI-assisted support tooling as a daily part of how you triage, troubleshoot, and route issues — not as a workaround, but as the workflow

- Support customers using Dutchie’s AI-native products and agentic platform modules that are actively expanding

- Bring genuine curiosity: experiment with new tools as they roll out, flag gaps when you find them, and contribute to how the tooling improves

- Contribute to internal documentation when you resolve something that wasn’t written down. Every gap you close makes the whole team faster

Documentation and escalation

- Write complete ticket documentation on every contact: issue reported, steps taken, outcome, and next steps

- Apply the 20-minute rule: if meaningful progress toward resolution hasn’t been made, escalate with full context

- Apply correct classifications, tags, and macros before closing or escalating

What you Bring

- 2+ years in a customer-facing support role, preferably supporting a SaaS platform

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, you can explain a technical issue in plain language

- Comfort troubleshooting across multiple product surfaces simultaneously

- Strong documentation habits: your internal notes are actionable without follow-up

- Professional composure with frustrated customers in high-urgency situations

- Comfort working in web-based software, CRMs, and Google Workspace

- Genuine appetite for AI tooling, you’re curious about how these tools work, willing to push on them, and energized rather than anxious when the technology around you is evolving fast

- Flexibility to work evenings, weekends, and holidays. This is a 7-day operation (5am–9pm PST)

It’s a Bonus if You Have…

- Experience with POS systems, retail operations technology, or cannabis compliance

- Familiarity with Zendesk, Salesforce, Slack, and Zoom

- Background in the cannabis industry or dispensary operations

- Experience with the Dutchie platform

Schedule

Full-time, remote. Hours of operation are 5am–9pm PST, 7 days a week. Availability for evenings, weekends, and holidays is required - schedules are set through a vacation bid process that gives you structure and predictability while keeping the team covered.

What you’ll get

The hourly rate is $24.04 based on the intended level.

In addition to cash compensation, our total rewards package includes:

- Medical benefits including dental and vision plans to ensure you always have the best care.

- Equity packages in the form of stock options to all employees.

- Technology (hardware, software, reading materials, etc..) allowance

- Flexible vacation and sick days

At Dutchie, we’re committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and teammates without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Dutchie believes that diversity and inclusion among our teammates is critical to our success, and we seek to recruit, develop and retain the most talented people from a diverse candidate pool.

jobs.description:
Headquarters: Oxford, UK

URL: https://getellipsis.com

Description

Ellipsis is emerging as a market leader in “GEO” for B2B technology companies. This is a high-impact, hands-on role in a fast-moving and ambitious agency.

The transition to AI search has put a lot of the SEO industry on the back foot. Ellipsis has always been consultative/strategic in our approach, we started building AI search products in 2021 on GPT-2, and thus this has been a time for us to thrive.

Today, we think we have a better understanding of AI search than almost anyone else. We have both the tracking product (built in-house), the data (~25 million AI answers for analysis, with more tracked weekly), and the execution end-to-end from strategy, to writing, to in-house design, to optimisation, and performance reporting.

We're looking for an Executive Assistant to help our Founder and Managing Director, Alex, and our Chief of Staff, Anna, make the best possible use of their time, while ensuring important work across the business is prepared, coordinated and followed through. You'll provide day-to-day EA support to Alex and work closely with Anna on wider business matters.

You will be the metronome that helps the business keep moving. Your work will be extremely high-impact, and you’ll be involved at a high level across the business. This is not a general operations role: your focus is excellent executive support, careful coordination and practical follow-through.

This position can be broken down as follows:

60% support to Alex.

40% support to Anna on wider business priorities, including finance and people administration.

Remote work requires trust, and in this role this will be absolutely critical. Trust is built over time, and accordingly your responsibilities will grow over time. Our hope is that you will prove indispensable to the business, but we understand it will take months to get to this place. Thus, below is a list of some of the responsibilities you’ll be able to grow into over time.

Support to Alex

Your most important responsibility is helping Alex maximise his time, protect his attention, reduce unnecessary context-switching, and stay focused on the work where he adds the most value.

- Calendar management: Own and manage Alex’s diary and calendar. Protect focused work and create space for strategic priorities. Make sensible scheduling decisions using your knowledge of Alex’s priorities, resolve clashes proactively, and account for preparation, travel time, location, time zones and the purpose of each meeting. Challenge or reorganise meetings where there is a better use of Alex’s time, and make sure Alex has the right preparation and information before important meetings.

- Inbox and communication: Assist the Managing Director with maintaining an organised and efficient inbox, including drafting replies or responding directly on his behalf at times. Effectively triage emails, understand possible courses of action, and present information to Alex in a way that lets him quickly provide a batch of responses that unblock you. Chase outstanding replies, actions and commitments, and build templates and systems for recurring email patterns so that important messages and obligations do not disappear.

- Briefings: Prepare a clear, concise morning briefing for Alex at the start of each day before he logs on (8.30am uk), giving him an overview of his schedule, priorities, deadlines, outstanding decisions and follow-up. Monitor his relevant communication channels, use judgement to identify what needs his attention, and make sure he is reminded of important to-dos, commitments and preparation ahead of time. These briefings are sometimes also required in the afternoon.

- Day-to-day tasks: The remit of this role is not “follow this clearly defined process every time”, but “take this mostly finished project and figure out how to proactively take it to completion”. These tasks might touch project management, writing/editing, triaging information, posting on LinkedIn, research, drafting communications and ensuring action is taken. You’ll need to work out the information, stakeholders, decisions and follow-up required, rather than waiting for every task to arrive as a fully documented process.

- Meetings: Prepare for meetings, including ensuring slides, agendas and internal notes are prepared. Your goal is to ensure we utilise meeting time most effectively and are able to put our best foot forward. Use approved AI tools to capture and summarise meetings where appropriate, then check the output for accuracy and missing nuance. Extract decisions, actions, owners and deadlines; create follow-up tasks and communications; and make sure agreed actions are completed. This is about excellent preparation and follow-through, rather than traditional minute-taking as an end in itself.

- Travel: Coordinate complex travel for Alex. Prepare clear itineraries and manage flights, hotels, transport, meetings, dinners and contingencies.

- Occasional personal administration: This is a business-focused role and the overwhelming responsibility is with the business. You may be occasionally asked to take care of personal admin for Alex where this meaningfully protects his time.

Support to Anna and the wider business

You will report directly to Anna. Outside of supporting Alex, your role is to help her deliver wider team and business priorities.

- Finance administration: This is an important part of the role. Support Anna with Ellipsis's day-to-day finance administration. This includes filing expenses, collecting invoices and receipts, preparing client invoices for review, gathering freelancer and supplier invoices, preparing payment information for approval, and chasing late client payments. You'll keep records accurate and tidy, help manage the finance inbox, and flag discrepancies promptly. Anna and our accountants remain responsible for payroll, pensions, compliance and all accounting decisions - your role is to make sure the inputs are complete, accurate and on time.

- People and team support: Support Anna with people administration. Keep HR records up to date, prepare routine paperwork, help coordinate onboarding and offboarding, track key dates such as probation reviews and contract renewals, and support recruitment logistics - scheduling interviews, managing candidate communications and keeping the pipeline tidy. You'll also help create a positive remote-team experience through thoughtful internal communications, recognition, celebrations and team rituals.

- Company meet-ups: Organise Ellipsis’s company meet-ups, including researching and budgeting locations, booking travel and accommodation, and arranging restaurants, meeting rooms and activities. You’ll need to think carefully about cost, travel time, comfort, accessibility, dietary requirements and contingencies to create a productive and smooth trip for the whole team.

- Wider business priorities: Take on well-scoped work that helps Anna and the Senior Leadership Team move wider company priorities forward. This might include preparing information and options, coordinating input from colleagues, drafting communications, updating trackers, following up actions and taking a partly formed request through to a reliable conclusion.

- Travel and conference support: Support Anna, Alex and, occasionally, other Leadership Team members with conference travel. This includes booking flights and hotels, preparing clear itineraries, organising client dinners or agreed gifts, and looking for ways to make their time away from the business as effective as possible.

- Confidentiality and judgement: You will handle confidential information relating to the business and team. You must use discretion, keep records accurate and know when a sensitive issue, decision or uncertainty needs to be escalated to Anna.

Requirements

Requirements: hard skills

- 2-4 years experience in an Executive Assistant or similar role; similar roles might include Personal Assistant, Team Assistant, Business Support Coordinator, Office Manager, Project Manager

- Impeccable English written and spoken communication and editorial skills

- Meticulous attention to detail

- Experience working remotely full time

- Availability to work 8am - 5pm UK time (or earlier)

- AI native: Confident using approved AI tools and automations to research, draft, summarise, organise and streamline administrative work. Able to write effective prompts, build repeatable workflows, review outputs critically for accuracy, tone and confidentiality, and recognise when human judgement or escalation is required.

Requirements: soft skills

- Fantastic communication skills: Remote work relies on mutual trust, so frequent and clear written communication is essential

- Receptive to feedback and solutions-oriented: We share and learn from each other honestly, openly, and easily

- A people person with a high level of self-awareness: You'll work daily with Alex, Anna, the wider team, suppliers, our accountants and client finance teams, so warmth, tact and good judgement about people are integral to the role

- Proven organisational skills: You must be obsessive with deadlines, managing and updating tasks, and totally reliable

- Self-driven work ethic: You need to be self-motivated, comfortable taking the initiative, and see projects through to completion

- Unwaveringly professional: You’ll be dealing with confidential information constantly and must be discreet and professional with this

- Calm when priorities change: You should be comfortable handling a mixture of planned and reactive work without losing sight of what matters most.

- Appetite for growth: As you build trust and company context, there will be scope for more sophisticated support to Alex, more complex Anna projects, deeper people and finance coordination, and practical AI and process improvements.

Your capability matters a lot more to us than your experience, and we would recommend you tailor your application with this in mind. We want to hear from you rather than ChatGPT. Please keep this in mind in particular with the screening questions.

Benefits

- This is a full-time, 100% remote role (UK/EU based). Work from home, or the beach!

- 28 days of paid holiday

- An additional 1 paid holiday day a year with each year of tenure, up to a maximum of 5 additional days

- 4-day work week, once a month (instead of local bank holidays seeing as we are based across the world)

- Regular team retreats; last was Istanbul, previously in Edinburgh, Oxford, Madrid, and Budapest

- Support for your growth, whether that’s upskilling, training, or exploring the direction you want to develop in

- Enhanced maternity/ paternity pay, and sick pay

The application process

It's important we find the best candidate for this position, and our selection process will reflect this.

Much of our company wiki is externally accessible, and you're encouraged to read through this before applying. We have a very useful guide to our interview process available here. This tells you what we're looking for and reading this will significantly increase your chance of success!

We'll review applications on a rolling basis but interviews start after the closing date. There's thus no benefit to rushing to apply: we will bias heavily towards your application's answers rather than your CV, and we'd love for you to take your time.

We're fortunate to receive a large volume of applications. You can make your application stand out by paying special attention to the main responsibilities of this role, and "how to apply". If you think you're a fit, or could be a fit – go for it!

We use video calls for interviews. You'll have video interviews using Google Meet, including with members of the Leadership Team and the Founder.

We understand that this is as much you interviewing us, as the other way round. Throughout the interview process, we're extremely happy to answer your questions about the business, working here, and the future of the company.

The final stage of our hiring process is a paid test project, which will be similar to work you could expect to do if you were hired. We'll give you a week to complete the project, and expect it to be 4-6 hours of work.

Following the completion of trial projects, we'll ask for professional references from your previous 2 managers. We ask candidates to introduce us to their references, for a 10 minute call.

We do great work for clients and are building an ethical business that lets everyone do their best work. If you think you could be the next person to join our team, please apply :)

How to apply

Please apply through Workable: https://apply.workable.com/getellipsis/j/C4645A1DB1/apply/. We will decide who progresses to the next stage based on the form you submit, and your CV. Please give us a good reason to select you! Taking the time to research the role, what we're looking for, what we do, and what you can do for us will increase your chance of success. Headquarters: Big Bear Lake, California, USA

URL: https://www.bigbearvacations.com/

OWNER EXPERIENCE SPECIALIST

Department: Owner Relations / Owner Experience
Market: Puerto Vallarta & Nuevo Vallarta, Mexico
Reports To: Director of Owner Relations
Employment Type: Contractor
Work Arrangement: 100% Remote / Monday - Saturday
Compensation: USD $1,200 monthly
Languages: Fluent English and Spanish, written and spoken — required

Position Purpose

The Owner Experience Specialist is the primary point of contact between Naya Homes and our homeowners in Puerto Vallarta and Nuevo Vallarta.

This role is responsible for building and maintaining strong, consistent, and proactive relationships with homeowners in order to support owner satisfaction and retention. Rather than simply reacting to problems after they occur, the Specialist is expected to identify potential concerns early and address them before they become reasons for an owner to consider terminating their relationship with Naya Homes.

The Specialist owns three key outcomes: executing the required owner communication cadence under the 33-Touch Relationship Model; providing homeowners with clear visibility into the condition and performance of their properties; and capturing property content that supports marketing efforts, social media, and owner communication.

The successful candidate will be highly organized, proactive, customer-focused, and comfortable managing a high volume of daily communication while maintaining accurate documentation and consistent follow-up.

Fluency in both English and Spanish, written and spoken, is an indispensable requirement for this position. The Specialist will communicate with homeowners and internal teams in both languages.

Because this is a remote contractor position, the primary focus is on achieving established goals, service standards, and KPIs. The schedule may be flexible as needed to ensure objectives are met, while maintaining the required availability and responsiveness for homeowners and the business.

Core Responsibilities

1. Owner Relationship Management & Communication

-
Execute 20–25 documented owner interactions per day through calls, email, and text.

-
Maintain 100% completion of required monthly touches for every assigned owner under the 33-Touch Relationship Model.

-
Maintain a balance across the three touch types:

-
Property Visibility: condition updates, inspection findings, photos, and property content.

-
Personal Relationship: relationship-building communication not directly related to a transaction or problem.

-
Informative / Value-Driven: performance, pricing, market conditions, and seasonal outlook.

-
Enter every interaction with a clear purpose and conclude it with a defined next step.

-
Complete scheduled owner check-in calls on the day they are due and rebook any rescheduled calls before the end of the same business day.

-
Maintain clear communication regarding availability, support, and expected response times so owners always know who to contact and when they can expect an answer.

-
Build trust and maintain professional, long-term relationships with homeowners.

2. Property Visibility & Owner Updates

-
Collect property updates from Operations, Housekeeping, Maintenance, and inspection reports.

-
Review condition notes and available photos before communicating with owners to ensure updates are specific and accurate.

-
Translate operational findings into clear, plain-language owner updates, including what was found, what action is being taken, associated costs, and expected resolution timelines.

-
Respond to all open owner conversations regarding work orders.

-
Ensure that no work order is dispatched to an owner's property without documented owner approval.

-
Ensure that every unresolved property issue has a clearly assigned next action and responsible person.

-
Provide owners with meaningful visibility into the work being performed on their property.

3. Escalation & Churn Risk Identification

-
Identify early signs of owner dissatisfaction or potential churn, including declining sentiment, slow or short responses, revenue complaints, recurring property condition issues, questions regarding contract terms, or references to other management companies.

-
Escalate concerns on the same business day.

-
Add applicable owners to the Owner Churn Board and keep records current as situations develop.

-
Confirm ownership of the next action for every escalation and ensure each open case has a clearly assigned responsible person.

-
Communicate potential risks early rather than waiting for issues to escalate.

4. Documentation & CRM Discipline

-
Log every owner interaction in Monday.com on the same day it occurs.

-
Maintain the Owner Churn Board on a daily basis.

-
Schedule all future owner touches and follow-ups before closing out the day.

-
Prepare a clear next-day action list before logging off.

-
Complete a weekly CRM documentation self-audit and correct any gaps identified.

-
Maintain accurate, complete, and timely records of all owner communications.

Daily Operating Rhythm

Start of Day

-
Log into RingCentral and Monday.com.

-
Review the Owner Engagement Tracker.

-
Identify owners due for required touches.

-
Review notes from inspections, maintenance, turnovers, and operations.

-
Flag owners with open concerns, negative or declining sentiment, or recent performance or condition issues.

During the Day

-
Complete scheduled owner check-in calls.

-
Send required emails and text messages.

-
Complete scheduled property-content activities remotely or through available internal resources.

-
Collect and communicate relevant property updates.

-
Respond to open work order conversations.

-
Escalate concerns on the same business day.

-
Maintain consistent follow-up with assigned homeowners.

End of Day

-
Ensure all owner interactions are documented in Monday.com.

-
Update the Owner Churn Board.

-
Schedule future touches and follow-ups.

-
Confirm that there are zero undocumented conversations.

-
Prepare the next-day action list.

Weekly Close

-
Maintain 100% progress toward required monthly owner touches.

-
Ensure there are no missed follow-ups.

-
Complete the CRM documentation self-audit.

-
Review owner sentiment trends.

-
Identify unresolved owner issues requiring attention.

-
Identify owners requiring proactive outreach during the following week.

Performance Standards & KPIs

Performance will be measured monthly against the following targets:

-
Daily owner touches: 20–25 per day.

-
Required monthly touch completion: 100%.

-
Documentation accuracy: 95% or higher.

-
Undocumented conversations: Zero.

-
Same-day escalation compliance: 100%.

-
Overdue escalations beyond SLA: Zero.

-
Owner sentiment trend: Stable or improving.

-
Overall KPI attainment: 90% or higher.

-
Retention saves: Tracked and reviewed through the Owner Churn Board.

Sustained performance below the established targets may result in a documented coaching plan.

Accountability Standards

-
Missed follow-ups are considered a performance issue.

-
Undocumented conversations are considered a performance issue.

-
Dispatching a work order without documented owner approval is considered a performance issue.

-
Early escalation is considered a positive behavior and is recognized accordingly.

-
Proactive communication is an expectation of the role, not an additional benefit or optional activity.

-
The Specialist is expected to take ownership of assigned conversations, follow-ups, and open issues through resolution or appropriate escalation.

Qualifications

Required

-
Fluent English and Spanish, both written and spoken — indispensable.

-
2+ years of experience in client-facing account management, hospitality, property management, customer success, or a related field.

-
Demonstrated experience working independently and managing responsibilities in a remote environment.

-
Strong CRM discipline and a proven track record of documenting work consistently without requiring constant follow-up.

-
Comfortable initiating a high volume of outbound calls and handling difficult conversations directly and professionally.

-
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both English and Spanish.

-
Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build trust with clients and maintain long-term relationships.

-
Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple conversations, follow-ups, and priorities simultaneously.

-
Proactive approach to identifying potential dissatisfaction and escalating concerns appropriately.

-
Ability to shoot and edit short-form vertical video using a phone and tools such as CapCut, Instagram, or equivalent.

-
Strong computer skills and ability to work independently with digital communication, CRM, and collaboration tools.

-
Reliable internet connection and a suitable home-office environment for remote work.

Preferred

-
Previous experience in short-term rentals, vacation rentals, hospitality, or property management.

-
Working knowledge of Streamline VRS, Monday.com, or comparable PMS/CRM platforms.

-
Experience producing content for Instagram, TikTok, Airbnb, or other property marketing platforms.

-
Understanding of owner statements, management fees, and short-term rental revenue basics.

-
Familiarity with the Puerto Vallarta / Nuevo Vallarta vacation rental market.

Key Attributes

The ideal candidate will be:

-
Reliable and consistent: Able to perform repetitive activities consistently and accurately.

-
Calm and professional: Comfortable dealing with frustrated homeowners without becoming defensive or over-promising.

-
Highly organized: Capable of managing 20–25 daily conversations while maintaining complete follow-up.

-
Proactive: Identifies potential issues early and takes action before they escalate.

-
Accountable: Communicates problems honestly and takes ownership of mistakes.

-
Relationship-oriented: Genuinely interested in understanding homeowners, their properties, and their needs.

-
Adaptable: Comfortable working independently in a remote environment and managing priorities without constant supervision.

-
Strong communicator: Able to communicate clearly and professionally in both English and Spanish.

First 90 Days

Days 1–30

-
Complete access and onboarding for Monday.com, Streamline, RingCentral, and the Owner Engagement Tracker.

-
Become confident using the required systems and communication tools.

-
Review the assigned owner portfolio.

-
Make introductory contact with assigned homeowners.

-
Complete shadowing and initial training.

Days 31–60

-
Execute the full daily communication volume of 20–25 owner touches.

-
Maintain 100% documentation compliance.

-
Demonstrate consistent follow-up and proactive communication.

-
Begin independently identifying and escalating owner concerns.

Days 61–90

-
Achieve overall KPI attainment of 90% or higher.

-
Own at least one owner retention case from identification through resolution or successful escalation.

-
Demonstrate consistent owner relationship management and CRM discipline.

-
Contribute repeatable content formats or communication practices that can be adopted by other Specialists.

This job description outlines the primary duties and standards of the role and is not an exhaustive list of all responsibilities. Duties may be adjusted according to business needs. Workload structure, escalation pathways, and coaching practices will be administered in accordance with applicable company policies and requirements.

Tu as envie de travailler dans un environnement bienveillant qui avance vite ? 5ème fournisseur français en 10 ans, Octopus Energy est un fournisseur d’énergies renouvelables qui agit comme un véritable fer de lance pour la révolution électro tech.
 
Comment on fait ?  On ne peut pas révolutionner le monde en travaillant comme tout le monde On essaye de ne pas trop se prendre la tête, ici on évolue dans un environnement sans trop de process ni trop de règles. Le plus important, ce n’est pas seulement de suivre le mouvement, mais de le créer.

On ne veut pas créer des clones d’entreprise. On te veut toi, avec tes talents, tes perspectives et tes compétences uniques.

Tu as envie de rejoindre une entreprise qui grandit vite, avec beaucoup d’autonomie et une façon assez différente de faire les People Ops ?
Bienvenue chez Octopus Energy France.
Chez nous, nous fonctionnons selon un modèle NoHR : les managers sont le premier point de contact people de leurs équipes. Le rôle de l’équipe People Ops est de leur donner le bon cadre, les bons outils, les bonnes informations et les bons réflexes pour qu’ils puissent être autonomes au quotidien.
Dans ce contexte, nous cherchons aujourd’hui quelqu’un de solide en People Ops, capable à la fois de construire et faire évoluer nos façons de travailler, mais aussi de contribuer concrètement au quotidien de l’équipe.
Le poste est organisé autour de deux grands volets, qui représentent chacun environ 50 % du rôle :
du build : projets People, outils, data, automatisation, IA, amélioration de nos process
du run : administration du personnel, paie, support aux managers et aux équipes, contrôle et fiabilisation des données
Cet équilibre n’est évidemment pas figé : selon les actualités, les projets ou les périodes de l’année, tu pourras passer davantage de temps sur l’un ou l’autre.
Ce qu’on cherche surtout, c’est quelqu’un qui aime construire des choses sans perdre le contact avec l’opérationnel.

1. Build : faire évoluer nos People Ops

Une partie importante de ton rôle sera de prendre en main des projets qui permettent à l’équipe People Ops et aux managers de travailler mieux, plus simplement et plus efficacement.

Tu pourras notamment :

-
piloter des projets People de bout en bout, de l’identification du besoin jusqu’à la mise en œuvre

-
simplifier et améliorer nos process

-
construire et faire évoluer notre Help Hub et notre documentation

-
construire des dashboards et des reportings utiles au pilotage : consolider et mieux exploiter les données issues de nos différents outils

-
automatiser certains contrôles, reportings ou tâches répétitives

-
identifier et tester des cas d’usage simples autour de l’IA et de l’automatisation

-
participer à des projets Groupe avec les équipes Octopus basées notamment au Royaume-Uni

-
accompagner les managers dans l’adoption de nouveaux outils ou de nouvelles façons de travailler

On cherche quelqu’un qui aime partir d’un besoin parfois encore un peu flou, le comprendre, le structurer et arriver à une solution concrète.

La data et l’IA sont des outils au service des People Ops et des équipes, pas une fin en soi. Nous ne cherchons donc ni un·e Data Analyst pur, ni un profil tech, mais quelqu’un qui sait s’en servir pour résoudre des problèmes opérationnels.

2. Run : contribuer au quotidien de l’équipe

L’autre moitié du poste consiste à être pleinement partie prenante des People Ops du quotidien.

Selon les besoins de l’équipe, tu pourras intervenir sur :

-
l’administration du personnel : contrats, avenants, mouvements, absences, sorties…

-
la préparation et le contrôle de la paie

-
le contrôle et la cohérence des données entre nos différents outils

-
les questions des managers et des salarié·es

-
le suivi et la résolution de sujets opérationnels

-
le support à l’équipe lors des périodes de forte activité ou lorsqu’un sujet urgent apparaît

L’idée n’est pas de te spécialiser dans l’administration ou la paie. En revanche, tu dois être à l’aise pour mettre les mains dedans, comprendre les sujets et apporter du support à l’équipe lorsque c’est nécessaire.

Chez nous, le run est aussi une source importante pour le build : c’est souvent en étant confronté·e aux irritants du quotidien qu’on identifie ce qu’il faut simplifier, automatiser ou repenser.

- tu as au moins 7 ans d’expérience en People Ops, HR Operations ou sur un rôle généraliste avec une forte dimension opérationnelle

-
tu as un très bon niveau d’anglais à l’oral (minimum B2-C1), indispensable pour travailler avec les équipes Octopus à l’international

-
tu as déjà travaillé dans un environnement start-up / scale-up, où il faut savoir naviguer dans l’ambiguïté, s’adapter vite et avancer sans que tout soit parfaitement cadré

-
tu es à l’aise avec le run People Ops : administration du personnel, paie, contrôle de données, support aux managers et aux équipes

-
tu es à l’aise avec la data et sais l’utiliser pour fiabiliser, analyser et mieux piloter

-
tu as déjà piloté des projets People et/ou outils, de la définition du besoin jusqu’à la mise en œuvre

-

-
tu es pragmatique : tu cherches des solutions simples, utiles et réellement utilisables

-
tu es autonome, à l’aise dans un environnement qui bouge vite, et capable de prioriser entre projets de fond et sujets opérationnels plus urgents

Pour être transparent, ce poste ne correspondra probablement pas à quelqu’un qui cherche :

-
un poste de Data Analyst / People Analyst pur

-
un rôle uniquement centré sur les projets, sans envie de contribuer au run

-
un poste principalement orienté paie ou administration du personnel

-
un poste purement tech

-
un rôle très stratégique ou de management, éloigné du quotidien des opérations

Nous cherchons quelqu’un de polyvalent et solide en People Ops, qui peut aussi bien passer une matinée à faire avancer un projet outil ou data qu’une après-midi à aider l’équipe sur de la paie, une incohérence de données ou une question manager.

jobs.description:
Chi siamo 
Il sistema energetico funziona meglio quando le persone possono farne parte. In Octopus Energy lo facciamo già ogni giorno: rendiamo l'energia più equa, pulita e accessibile grazie alla tecnologia.
Presenti in Italia dal 2022, siamo partiti da Ascoli Piceno, dove abbiamo la nostra sede. Oggi abbiamo superato un milione di utenze, con un team di oltre 300 persone tra Ascoli Piceno, Milano e Roma, e più di 250 milioni di euro investiti nel Paese. Una crescita nata da un modo diverso di fare energia: più semplice, più umano, più tecnologico.
Come lavoriamo 
Non siamo una compagnia tradizionale e non vogliamo diventarlo. Non ci piacciono la burocrazia, le procedure inutili o i reparti che si scaricano i problemi a vicenda. Quando un cliente ha bisogno di aiuto, vogliamo che trovi persone capaci di ascoltare, prendersi la responsabilità e risolvere.
Questo approccio ci ha portati a essere valutati 4,9/5 su Trustpilot, a vincere la classifica Altroconsumo e a ricevere il premio "Miglior Servizio Clienti" del Corriere della Sera.
La tecnologia al servizio di tutti
Qui la tecnologia non è riservata a pochi esperti: è uno strumento che aiuta tutti a lavorare meglio. Non serve essere un mago del computer, ma serve curiosità. Usiamo dati, automazione e intelligenza artificiale per togliere complessità, capire meglio i problemi e dedicare più energia a ciò che conta: migliorare il modo in cui le persone vivono l’energia.
Cosa troverai in Octopus
Octopus è un posto per chi vuole portare energia e buon senso. I problemi non arrivano sempre ordinati, le risposte non sono sempre già scritte e spesso c’è da costruire mentre si corre. Ma non sarai solo: lavorerai con persone curiose, generose e concrete, che si aiutano a vicenda e vogliono lasciare le cose meglio di come le hanno trovate. Stiamo già migliorando il modo in cui l’energia funziona per le persone: se vuoi prenderti responsabilità e contribuire a questo cambiamento, qui il tuo lavoro può avere un impatto vero.
 

Il ruolo
Nelle compagnie energetiche tradizionali, quando un cliente ha bisogno di aiuto, spesso passa da un reparto all’altro, ripete le stesse informazioni e aspetta che qualcuno rimetta insieme i pezzi.
In Octopus lavoriamo in modo diverso: usiamo tecnologia, dati e lavoro di squadra per avere le informazioni giuste al momento giusto, ridurre i passaggi inutili e seguire ogni richiesta dall’inizio alla fine.
Sarai il punto di riferimento del cliente. Ascolterai le sue esigenze, userai la tecnologia e gli strumenti a disposizione, collaborerai con il tuo team e accompagnerai il cliente fino alla soluzione.
È un ruolo che unisce relazione, ragionamento e operatività. Servono empatia, giudizio, flessibilità e senso di responsabilità.
Non serve avere già esperienza nel settore energetico. Molte delle persone che oggi lavorano in questo ruolo sono entrate senza conoscerlo: ti daremo formazione, strumenti e supporto per imparare passo dopo passo.

⚡ Renderai l’energia più semplice. Aiuterai i clienti a capire bollette, contatori, tariffe e pratiche senza usare parole incomprensibili e senza complicazioni.

💡 Troverai soluzioni concrete. Userai tecnologia, portali e lavoro di squadra per gestire anche i casi più complessi.

📞 Seguirai il cliente dall’inizio alla fine. Niente rimbalzi tra reparti: ti prenderai cura di ogni richiesta fino alla soluzione, reclami inclusi. Lo aiuterai al telefono, via e-mail e su WhatsApp.

🧠 Ragionerai con la tua testa. Niente copioni, niente risposte automatiche: solo conversazioni vere, in cui ascolti, capisci e trovi la risposta più utile.

❤️ Aiuterai ogni cliente come aiuteresti tua nonna. Con chiarezza, gentilezza e voglia di fare un passo in più, perché per noi il servizio clienti si fa così.

🌍 Farai la differenza. Che tu stia aiutando qualcuno a capire meglio la propria bolletta o a scegliere soluzioni energetiche più sostenibili, il tuo lavoro avrà un impatto concreto.

-
Ti piace aiutare le persone, davvero: ti dà soddisfazione capire un’esigenza, sciogliere un dubbio e risolvere un problema.

-
Sai ascoltare e comunicare in modo semplice, diretto e umano, anche quando devi spiegare temi complessi o gestire situazioni delicate.

-
Non devi conoscere già il settore energetico: conta di più la voglia di imparare, capire i problemi e trovare soluzioni.

-
Prendi iniziativa, non ti fermi alla prima difficoltà e ti piace seguire un caso dall’inizio alla fine.

-
Ti riconosci in un modo di lavorare che mette insieme tecnologia, responsabilità personale e lavoro di squadra.

-
In Octopus fare bene il tuo lavoro è naturale: trovi le condizioni giuste per esprimerti al meglio, perché i tuoi obiettivi, quelli dei colleghi e quelli dell’azienda sono perfettamente allineati

-
Lavorerai con persone curiose, brillanti e concrete, che hanno voglia di fare bene e migliorare davvero le cose.

-
Lavorerai per un’azienda che le persone scelgono perché si fidano: abbiamo un servizio clienti valutato 4,9/5 su Trustpilot e premiato da Altroconsumo e dal Corriere della Sera.

-
Farai parte di una realtà concreta, veloce e poco burocratica, dove contano i risultati, il modo in cui li raggiungiamo e l’impatto che creiamo per i clienti.

-
Octopus Energy è un luogo in cui le persone hanno spazio per imparare, prendersi responsabilità e fare davvero la differenza.

-
Equity Options Scheme: in Octopus puoi avere accesso a opzioni su azioni del Gruppo. In pratica, puoi possedere la tua parte di Octopus Energy e partecipare al valore che costruiamo insieme.

-
Focus sul tuo benessere: ti supportiamo con vantaggi concreti come i buoni pasto e un accesso gratuito a sessioni di benessere psicologico.

-
Cultura: ogni settimana, il venerdì, ci riuniamo tutti per gli aggiornamenti aziendali e un brindisi. Lo chiamiamo Family Dinner.

OEGen is a specialist energy investment manager overseeing more than £8 billion of assets under management. Our mission is to accelerate the transition to a net zero energy system by investing in clean energy infrastructure and energy transition businesses across multiple jurisdictions.
As our international portfolio continues to grow, we are looking to strengthen our in-house tax capability with the addition of a commercially minded tax professional who is keen to develop within a fast-paced investment environment.

The Role

We are looking for a Tax Assistant Manager / emerging Tax Manager to join the OEGen Tax Team, reporting directly to the Funds & Deals Tax Lead. The successful candidate will join the tax function at Sky Generation, the UK clean energy infrastructure platform of the Sky Fund, which owns and manages a number of international operating platforms. These businesses are active across Europe and beyond, developing, investing in and managing renewable energy and broader energy transition assets.
This is a strong opportunity for someone with around 4–5 years’ experience who is looking to step into a broader international role and continue developing their technical, commercial and project management capabilities within a growing infrastructure investment environment.

The role will support the Sky Fund’s portfolio and associated holding structures across multiple jurisdictions. You will work closely with investment teams, finance teams, portfolio companies and external advisers on a broad range of tax matters, including tax compliance oversight, reporting, transactions, structuring and ongoing portfolio support.
The position offers wide exposure to international investment structures, cross-border transactions and the full lifecycle of infrastructure investments, while working within a collaborative, hands-on and growing in-house tax team.

- Support the management of tax matters across OEGen funds and associated holding structures.

- Coordinate international tax compliance processes with local advisors across multiple jurisdictions.

- Assist with tax reporting, tax provisioning, and financial statement disclosures.

- Support tax workstreams on acquisitions, restructurings, refinancings, and other transactions.

- Review transaction and financing documentation from a tax perspective, with support from senior team members where needed.

- Monitor tax risks and support ongoing governance and compliance processes.

- Work closely with investment, finance, legal, and external advisory teams across the business.

- Contribute to the continuous improvement of internal tax processes and documentation.

- Around 4–5 years’ experience in corporate tax.

- CTA, ACA, or equivalent qualification (or close to qualification).

- Experience gained in a Big 4 firm, international advisory firm, law firm, or in-house tax team.

- Good grounding in tax compliance, reporting, and tax accounting.

- Exposure to cross-border structures or international tax matters is helpful, but deep expertise is not expected.

- An interest in infrastructure, energy, or investment management is a plus.

- Foreign language skills (particularly German, French, Spanish, or Italian) would be beneficial but are not required.

jobs.title: Energy Specialist
jobs.summary: Chi siamo Il sistema energetico funziona meglio quando le persone possono farne parte.
jobs.description:
Chi siamo 
Il sistema energetico funziona meglio quando le persone possono farne parte. In Octopus Energy lo facciamo già ogni giorno: rendiamo l'energia più equa, pulita e accessibile grazie alla tecnologia.
Presenti in Italia dal 2022, siamo partiti da Ascoli Piceno, dove abbiamo la nostra sede. Oggi abbiamo superato un milione di utenze, con un team di oltre 300 persone tra Ascoli Piceno, Milano e Roma, e più di 250 milioni di euro investiti nel Paese. Una crescita nata da un modo diverso di fare energia: più semplice, più umano, più tecnologico.
Come lavoriamo 
Non siamo una compagnia tradizionale e non vogliamo diventarlo. Non ci piacciono la burocrazia, le procedure inutili o i reparti che si scaricano i problemi a vicenda. Quando un cliente ha bisogno di aiuto, vogliamo che trovi persone capaci di ascoltare, prendersi la responsabilità e risolvere.
Questo approccio ci ha portati a essere valutati 4,9/5 su Trustpilot, a vincere la classifica Altroconsumo e a ricevere il premio "Miglior Servizio Clienti" del Corriere della Sera.
La tecnologia al servizio di tutti
Qui la tecnologia non è riservata a pochi esperti: è uno strumento che aiuta tutti a lavorare meglio. Non serve essere un mago del computer, ma serve curiosità. Usiamo dati, automazione e intelligenza artificiale per togliere complessità, capire meglio i problemi e dedicare più energia a ciò che conta: migliorare il modo in cui le persone vivono l’energia.
Cosa troverai in Octopus
Octopus è un posto per chi vuole portare energia e buon senso. I problemi non arrivano sempre ordinati, le risposte non sono sempre già scritte e spesso c’è da costruire mentre si corre. Ma non sarai solo: lavorerai con persone curiose, generose e concrete, che si aiutano a vicenda e vogliono lasciare le cose meglio di come le hanno trovate. Stiamo già migliorando il modo in cui l’energia funziona per le persone: se vuoi prenderti responsabilità e contribuire a questo cambiamento, qui il tuo lavoro può avere un impatto vero.
 

Il ruolo
Nelle compagnie energetiche tradizionali, quando un cliente ha bisogno di aiuto, spesso passa da un reparto all’altro, ripete le stesse informazioni e aspetta che qualcuno rimetta insieme i pezzi.
In Octopus lavoriamo in modo diverso: usiamo tecnologia, dati e lavoro di squadra per avere le informazioni giuste al momento giusto, ridurre i passaggi inutili e seguire ogni richiesta dall’inizio alla fine.
Sarai il punto di riferimento del cliente. Ascolterai le sue esigenze, userai la tecnologia e gli strumenti a disposizione, collaborerai con il tuo team e accompagnerai il cliente fino alla soluzione.
È un ruolo che unisce relazione, ragionamento e operatività. Servono empatia, giudizio, flessibilità e senso di responsabilità.
Non serve avere già esperienza nel settore energetico. Molte delle persone che oggi lavorano in questo ruolo sono entrate senza conoscerlo: ti daremo formazione, strumenti e supporto per imparare passo dopo passo.
 

⚡ Renderai l’energia più semplice. Aiuterai i clienti a capire bollette, contatori, tariffe e pratiche senza usare parole incomprensibili e senza complicazioni.

💡 Troverai soluzioni concrete. Userai tecnologia, portali e lavoro di squadra per gestire anche i casi più complessi.

📞 Seguirai il cliente dall’inizio alla fine. Niente rimbalzi tra reparti: ti prenderai cura di ogni richiesta fino alla soluzione, reclami inclusi. Lo aiuterai al telefono, via e-mail e su WhatsApp.

🧠 Ragionerai con la tua testa. Niente copioni, niente risposte automatiche: solo conversazioni vere, in cui ascolti, capisci e trovi la risposta più utile.

❤️ Aiuterai ogni cliente come aiuteresti tua nonna. Con chiarezza, gentilezza e voglia di fare un passo in più, perché per noi il servizio clienti si fa così.

🌍 Farai la differenza. Che tu stia aiutando qualcuno a capire meglio la propria bolletta o a scegliere soluzioni energetiche più sostenibili, il tuo lavoro avrà un impatto concreto.

-
Ti piace aiutare le persone, davvero: ti dà soddisfazione capire un’esigenza, sciogliere un dubbio e risolvere un problema.

-
Sai ascoltare e comunicare in modo semplice, diretto e umano, anche quando devi spiegare temi complessi o gestire situazioni delicate.

-
Non devi conoscere già il settore energetico: conta di più la voglia di imparare, capire i problemi e trovare soluzioni.

-
Prendi iniziativa, non ti fermi alla prima difficoltà e ti piace seguire un caso dall’inizio alla fine.

-
Ti riconosci in un modo di lavorare che mette insieme tecnologia, responsabilità personale e lavoro di squadra.

-
In Octopus fare bene il tuo lavoro è naturale: trovi le condizioni giuste per esprimerti al meglio, perché i tuoi obiettivi, quelli dei colleghi e quelli dell’azienda sono perfettamente allineati

-
Lavorerai con persone curiose, brillanti e concrete, che hanno voglia di fare bene e migliorare davvero le cose.

-
Lavorerai per un’azienda che le persone scelgono perché si fidano: abbiamo un servizio clienti valutato 4,9/5 su Trustpilot e premiato da Altroconsumo e dal Corriere della Sera.

-
Farai parte di una realtà concreta, veloce e poco burocratica, dove contano i risultati, il modo in cui li raggiungiamo e l’impatto che creiamo per i clienti.

-
Octopus Energy è un luogo in cui le persone hanno spazio per imparare, prendersi responsabilità e fare davvero la differenza.

-
Equity Options Scheme: in Octopus puoi avere accesso a opzioni su azioni del Gruppo. In pratica, puoi possedere la tua parte di Octopus Energy e partecipare al valore che costruiamo insieme.

-
Focus sul tuo benessere: ti supportiamo con vantaggi concreti come i buoni pasto e un accesso gratuito a sessioni di benessere psicologico.

-
Cultura: ogni settimana, il venerdì, ci riuniamo tutti per gli aggiornamenti aziendali e un brindisi. Lo chiamiamo Family Dinner.

-
Disponibilità: immediata

-
Ore: Tempo pieno

jobs.description:
Tu as envie de travailler dans un environnement bienveillant qui avance vite ? 5ème fournisseur français en 10 ans, Octopus Energy est un fournisseur d’énergies renouvelables qui agit comme un véritable fer de lance pour la révolution électro tech.
 
Comment on fait ?  On ne peut pas révolutionner le monde en travaillant comme tout le monde On essaye de ne pas trop se prendre la tête, ici on évolue dans un environnement sans trop de process ni trop de règles. Le plus important, ce n’est pas seulement de suivre le mouvement, mais de le créer.

On ne veut pas créer des clones d’entreprise. On te veut toi, avec tes talents, tes perspectives et tes compétences uniques.

Tu as envie de rejoindre une entreprise qui grandit vite, avec beaucoup d’autonomie et une façon assez différente de faire les People Ops ?
Bienvenue chez Octopus Energy France.
Chez nous, nous fonctionnons selon un modèle NoHR : les managers sont le premier point de contact people de leurs équipes. Le rôle de l’équipe People Ops est de leur donner le bon cadre, les bons outils, les bonnes informations et les bons réflexes pour qu’ils puissent être autonomes au quotidien.
Dans ce contexte, nous cherchons aujourd’hui quelqu’un de solide en People Ops, capable à la fois de construire et faire évoluer nos façons de travailler, mais aussi de contribuer concrètement au quotidien de l’équipe.
Le poste est organisé autour de deux grands volets, qui représentent chacun environ 50 % du rôle :
du build : projets People, outils, data, automatisation, IA, amélioration de nos process
du run : administration du personnel, paie, support aux managers et aux équipes, contrôle et fiabilisation des données
Cet équilibre n’est évidemment pas figé : selon les actualités, les projets ou les périodes de l’année, tu pourras passer davantage de temps sur l’un ou l’autre.
Ce qu’on cherche surtout, c’est quelqu’un qui aime construire des choses sans perdre le contact avec l’opérationnel.

1. Build : faire évoluer nos People Ops

Une partie importante de ton rôle sera de prendre en main des projets qui permettent à l’équipe People Ops et aux managers de travailler mieux, plus simplement et plus efficacement.

Tu pourras notamment :

-
piloter des projets People de bout en bout, de l’identification du besoin jusqu’à la mise en œuvre

-
simplifier et améliorer nos process

-
construire et faire évoluer notre Help Hub et notre documentation

-
construire des dashboards et des reportings utiles au pilotage : consolider et mieux exploiter les données issues de nos différents outils

-
automatiser certains contrôles, reportings ou tâches répétitives

-
identifier et tester des cas d’usage simples autour de l’IA et de l’automatisation

-
participer à des projets Groupe avec les équipes Octopus basées notamment au Royaume-Uni

-
accompagner les managers dans l’adoption de nouveaux outils ou de nouvelles façons de travailler

On cherche quelqu’un qui aime partir d’un besoin parfois encore un peu flou, le comprendre, le structurer et arriver à une solution concrète.

La data et l’IA sont des outils au service des People Ops et des équipes, pas une fin en soi. Nous ne cherchons donc ni un·e Data Analyst pur, ni un profil tech, mais quelqu’un qui sait s’en servir pour résoudre des problèmes opérationnels.

2. Run : contribuer au quotidien de l’équipe

L’autre moitié du poste consiste à être pleinement partie prenante des People Ops du quotidien.

Selon les besoins de l’équipe, tu pourras intervenir sur :

-
l’administration du personnel : contrats, avenants, mouvements, absences, sorties…

-
la préparation et le contrôle de la paie

-
le contrôle et la cohérence des données entre nos différents outils

-
les questions des managers et des salarié·es

-
le suivi et la résolution de sujets opérationnels

-
le support à l’équipe lors des périodes de forte activité ou lorsqu’un sujet urgent apparaît

L’idée n’est pas de te spécialiser dans l’administration ou la paie. En revanche, tu dois être à l’aise pour mettre les mains dedans, comprendre les sujets et apporter du support à l’équipe lorsque c’est nécessaire.

Chez nous, le run est aussi une source importante pour le build : c’est souvent en étant confronté·e aux irritants du quotidien qu’on identifie ce qu’il faut simplifier, automatiser ou repenser.

- tu as au moins 7 ans d’expérience en People Ops, HR Operations ou sur un rôle généraliste avec une forte dimension opérationnelle

-
tu as un très bon niveau d’anglais à l’oral (minimum B2-C1), indispensable pour travailler avec les équipes Octopus à l’international

-
tu as déjà travaillé dans un environnement start-up / scale-up, où il faut savoir naviguer dans l’ambiguïté, s’adapter vite et avancer sans que tout soit parfaitement cadré

-
tu es à l’aise avec le run People Ops : administration du personnel, paie, contrôle de données, support aux managers et aux équipes

-
tu es à l’aise avec la data et sais l’utiliser pour fiabiliser, analyser et mieux piloter

-
tu as déjà piloté des projets People et/ou outils, de la définition du besoin jusqu’à la mise en œuvre

-
tu es très à l’aise avec Google Sheets / Excel et, plus largement, avec un environnement de travail digital : Google Workspace, Slack, MacBook…

-
tu es pragmatique : tu cherches des solutions simples, utiles et réellement utilisables

-
tu es autonome, à l’aise dans un environnement qui bouge vite, et capable de prioriser entre projets de fond et sujets opérationnels plus urgents

Pour être transparent, ce poste ne correspondra probablement pas à quelqu’un qui cherche :

-
un poste de Data Analyst / People Analyst pur

-
un rôle uniquement centré sur les projets, sans envie de contribuer au run

-
un poste principalement orienté paie ou administration du personnel

-
un poste purement tech

-
un rôle très stratégique ou de management, éloigné du quotidien des opérations

Nous cherchons quelqu’un de polyvalent et solide en People Ops, qui peut aussi bien passer une matinée à faire avancer un projet outil ou data qu’une après-midi à aider l’équipe sur de la paie, une incohérence de données ou une question manager.
